purpose: Citation-function side register (Marathon R10 lane BA; Jurgens et al. six frames, TACL 2018, CC BY 4.0 — pattern only). One appended line per hand-applied label: {kind: 'citation-function', citation_id: lockfile citation id, page: wiki page, source: raw source, frame: one of Background/Motivation/Uses/Extension/Comparison-or-Contrast/Future, recorded: YYYY-MM-DD, note: str}. Separate register only — no schema change to pages or the lockfile, no model call. Maintained with scripts/wiki_citation_functions.py. This header line is the only line until an operator records a label — seeded empty-but-valid.
